question: Explain whether every constitutional monarch has the same executive powers.
raw: O1: [S5] The powers of constitutional monarchs vary. In some countries, the monarch has virtually no executive or policy-making power, while in other countries, the monarch has meaningful formal powers (such as veto power, appointment power, and power to dissolve parliament).
